title: Junta coefficient sample sequence
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, and let the failure parameter be rational and lie in $(0,1/2]$. Given a batch of restricted examples, indexed by the restricted sample count and consisting of an assignment of signs to the coordinates outside $P$ together with a sign label, and a subset $S$ in the low-degree Fourier family, the coefficient sample sequence has length equal to the coefficient estimation sample count. Its entries are the reindexed restriction examples selected from the batch by the prescribed coefficient sample indices for $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$
The failure parameter is rational and lies in $(0,1/2]$
The batch is a function on the indices up to the restricted sample count, with each value an assignment on coordinates outside $P$ paired with a sign
$S$ belongs to the low-degree junta Fourier family
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the reindexing map or the prescribed sample-index function, so their exact selection rule cannot be stated.
